newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat in lacklustre physical market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat in lacklustre physical market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was flat on Friday in a quiet market, traders said.
Naphtha swaps were slightly lower at $183.50/$184.50 a tonne for May and $187/$188 a tonne for June paper.
Traders said that although May still looked a bit sloppy the prospects for June were slightly brighter.
One player said he had sold 12-14,000 tonnes worth of barges of light virgin naphtha out of Antwerp over the past couple of days at a rate of cif mean quotes on a fob basis.
Full-range cif NWE cargoes were quoted around $180/$184 for May delivery, and $3-$5 above there for June.
